_comment: Prices for models no gateway lists, in USD per single token.
Values are converted from DeepSeek's published per-million rates at
https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/ - read on 2026-10-03. DeepSeek bills peak and
off-peak separately, so an entry may carry peak/offPeak instead of input/output/cacheRead.
Peak hours are 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday; everything else is off-peak.
Chinese public holidays are excluded from peak in DeepSeek's terms and this cannot detect them,
so a holiday weekday inside a peak window is billed here at the peak rate. The error is at most
a doubling on those hours and runs in the conservative direction.
_legacy: DeepSeek states that deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are retired names, served by the same V4.1-Flash model and billed at the Flash price.
